name: Alabama Crimson Cubing Spring 2025

venue.name: John England, Jr. Hall
venue.details: The competition will take place in the basement level multipurpose room. Entrances are outside facing Palmer Lake and Lakeside Dining Hall.

information: **UA Students & Alumni:** After registering, send an ACT card screenshot or proof of a crimson email address to the organizers to qualify for the reduced registration fee of $15. **Note:** Competitors under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a parent/guardian at all times. ![southeastcubing.org](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDI1NzIsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--9de1c0ebe62c6dc55566d579b73b3e7217ed5110/SOUTHEAST_5.png) This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/home), and organized by Alabama Crimson Cubing, the University of Alabama's cubing club.
